note: Flow: a kanban board. Boards are tabs; the board, swimlanes by member, a table of every card or a timeline of due dates shares a split with the chosen card's drawer, or the board's insights. Drag a card to another column, use « and », Alt and the arrows, or right-click it for its menu; double-click it or press Cmd+Enter to open it as a page, Enter to edit it. Cmd+P goes to a card, Cmd+Shift+P runs a command, Cmd+N types a new card, Cmd+F searches, Cmd+Z undoes, Cmd+J switches light and dark, Cmd+L the language, Cmd+, opens the settings, Escape closes the issue page, then clears the filters.

computed.allCards: {{parseJson('[' + join(filter(map(state.columns, slice(join(split(json(map(it.cards, { at: index, ref: it.ref, priority: it.priority, due: it.due, points: it.points, start: it.start, tag: it.tag, title: it.title, who: it.who })), '{"at":'), '{"c":' + index + ',"at":'), 1, -1)), it != ''), ',') + ']')}}
computed.rows: {{map(computed.allCards, { id: it.c + '-' + it.at, cells: [it.title, state.columns[it.c].name, it.tag, it.who, it.points] })}}
computed.picks: {{map(computed.allCards, { title: it.title, detail: it.ref + ' · ' + state.columns[it.c].name, run: 'goToCard', with: { item: { c: it.c, at: it.at } } })}}
computed.tableColumns: {{[{ id: 'title', title: t('table.card'), width: state.columnWidths.title }, { id: 'column', title: t('table.column'), width: state.columnWidths.column }, { id: 'tag', title: t('table.label'), width: state.columnWidths.tag }, { id: 'who', title: t('table.owner'), width: state.columnWidths.who }, { id: 'points', title: t('table.points'), width: state.columnWidths.points }]}}
computed.palette: {{map(concat(computed.paletteFirst, filter(commands, it.enabled && it.category == 'Issue' && !contains(map(computed.paletteFirst, it.name), it.name)), filter(commands, it.enabled && it.category != 'Issue')), { title: it.title, detail: it.keyLabel ?? '', run: it.name })}}
computed.matches: {{filter(computed.allCards, (state.scope == 'all' || (state.scope == 'backlog' ? it.c == 0 : it.c > 0 && it.c < length(state.columns) - 1)) && (state.filter == 'all' || it.tag == state.filter) && (state.fStatus < 0 || it.c == state.fStatus) && (state.fPrio < 0 || (it.priority ?? 0) == state.fPrio) && (state.query == '' || fuzzy(state.query, it.title) != null))}}
computed.filterOptions: {{state.filterProp == 'status' ? map(state.columns, { v: index, title: it.name, icon: state.statusIcons[index] ?? 'circle', color: it.color, on: state.fStatus == index }) : state.filterProp == 'assignee' ? map(state.members, { v: it.who, title: it.name, icon: 'circle-user', color: it.color, on: state.owner == it.who }) : state.filterProp == 'priority' ? map(state.priorities, { v: index, title: t('priority.' + index), icon: it, color: '@color.muted', on: state.fPrio == index }) : map(slice(state.filters, 1), { v: it, title: t('tag.' + it), icon: 'circle', color: '@' + it, on: state.filter == it })}}
computed.activeFilters: {{concat(state.fStatus >= 0 ? [{ prop: 'status', value: state.columns[state.fStatus].name }] : [], state.owner != '' ? [{ prop: 'assignee', value: find(state.members, it.who == state.owner).name ?? state.owner }] : [], state.fPrio >= 0 ? [{ prop: 'priority', value: t('priority.' + state.fPrio) }] : [], state.filter != 'all' ? [{ prop: 'label', value: t('tag.' + state.filter) }] : [])}}
computed.next: {{state.selected == null ? computed.visible[0] : find(computed.visible, it.c > state.selected.c || (it.c == state.selected.c && it.at > state.selected.i))}}
computed.prev: {{state.selected == null ? null : computed.visible[count(computed.visible, it.c < state.selected.c || (it.c == state.selected.c && it.at < state.selected.i)) - 1]}}
computed.propItems: {{state.propKind == 'status' ? map(state.columns, { title: it.name, detail: index == state.selected.c ? '✓' : '', run: 'setStatus', with: { to: index } }) : state.propKind == 'priority' ? map(state.priorities, { title: t('priority.' + index), detail: index == (computed.card.priority ?? 0) ? '✓' : '', run: 'setPriority', with: { p: index } }) : map(state.members, { title: it.name, detail: it.who == computed.card.who ? '✓' : it.who, run: 'setAssignee', with: { who: it.who } })}}
